signals.source_text: The COMPASS Lab of the Department of Aerospace Science and Technology - Politecnico di Milano at Politecnico di Milano is thrilled to have participated in the 2026 AAS/AIAA Astrodynamics Specialist Conference, held in Whistler, Canada. The conference brought together leading researchers from around the world in the field of #Astrodynamics , covering topics such as trajectory design and optimisation, spacecraft guidance, navigation and control, proximity operations, #SpaceDebris , and many others. The lab was represented by PhD students Alessandro Michelazzi , Eduardo Polli and Wiebke Retagne , who delivered oral presentations on the following topics: • “Adaptive GNSS-Based #RelativeNavigation for Close #FormationFlying Under Continuous Low-Thrust” - Alessandro Michelazzi , Gabriella Gaias , Camilla Colombo • “ #CollisionAvoidanceManoeuvre Design Under Operational Constraints Using Reaction Control Thrusters” - Eduardo Polli , Juan Luis Gonzalo Gómez , Camilla Colombo • “Generational Evolution of #ExplosionProbability : Investigating the Influence of #MitigationMeasures ” - Wiebke Retagne , Andrea Muciaccia , Camilla Colombo Pre-print versions of the papers are available through the conference website: https://lnkd.in/ejrccH5h Their work was supported by the #GREENSPECIES project, funded by the European Research Council (ERC) , and the Space It Up! project, funded by the Agenzia Spaziale Italiana and the Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca .

signals.source_text: An autonomous aircraft flew in Utah. This week, we welcomed Joby Aviation as the company remotely operated its supervised autonomous J208 aircraft in Utah as part of its Electric Skies tour, a 5,541-nautical-mile journey across the country. Flights like this give us real-world data to help answer important questions about how autonomous aircraft can safely operate in Utah, from infrastructure and operations to future standards and best practices. That’s where uFLY comes in. Led by our team through an FAA pilot program, uFLY brings together five states to test and prepare for the safe integration of electric and advanced aircraft into our transportation and aviation systems. The future of flight might sound far away, but it’s getting here quickly. Our job is to be ready for it and make sure it’s safe. See the flight in action below. 👇 #TeamUDOT #AAM #uFLY

signals.source_text: At BlueTIDE 2026, 15 organizations integrated 25+ maritime platforms into Lattice and ran them as one operating picture. Ports are one of the hardest environments to secure. Military assets, commercial shipping, and civilian traffic share the same water, and the sensors meant to protect it sit in disconnected silos, so no single operator sees the whole environment. Our goal was to prove Lattice can be the common software layer that ties those systems into one view. The result is a repeatable model: the Lattice SDK turns individual technologies into a unified system, one that can support the defense of civil and military infrastructure.

signals.source_text: The EV didn't make NVH easier. It pushed the noise higher. Motor whine past 5 kHz. Gear mesh. Inverter harmonics. Road noise now the loudest source in the cabin. The critical band runs 100 Hz to 5 kHz, and no single method covers it. The Engineer's Guide to Modern NVH Simulation shows how to work the full range in MSC Nastran and Actran: heavy-fluid coupling, Virtual SEA, and ODYSSEE ROMs. Preview the first pages, then download the full guide below 👇

signals.source_text: Привет, LinkedIn! В своём Telegram-канале я веду рубрику «Резюме под микроскопом», где разбираю фрагменты резюме кандидатов и показываю, что в них можно усилить, чего не хватает и на что обращает внимание HR при первом просмотре. Решила попробовать перенести рубрику и сюда. Посмотрим, приживётся ли она в LinkedIn 😊 Как будет проходить рубрика? Периодически я буду публиковать реальный фрагмент резюме — разумеется, без персональных данных — и предлагать вам посмотреть на него глазами HR или рекрутера. Ваша задача — поделиться своим мнением в комментариях: • Что здесь вызывает вопросы? • Чего не хватает? • Что можно улучшить? • Как бы вы сформулировали этот блок? После этого я опубликую свой разбор и расскажу, на что обращаю внимание как HR, какие моменты могут затруднить первичную оценку кандидата и как можно усилить этот фрагмент, чтобы опыт специалиста был понятнее и лучше считывался работодателем. А теперь предлагаю начать. Первый фрагмент уже перед вами 👇 Что бы вы здесь изменили? // Все посты на эту тему будут под тегом - #Резюме_под_микроскопом
